title: Logarithms
intro: Read this before the logarithm questions. A logarithm is an exponent in disguise.

blocks.title: definition
blocks.body: $b^{y}=a\iff\log_b a=y$, with $a>0$, $b>0$ and $b\neq1$. Ask yourself: **what power of $b$ gives $a$?**

blocks.title: special values and the two common bases
never
items: The number inside a logarithm must be **positive**.

blocks.title: typed answers
blocks.body: Write logarithms as `log(` (base 10), `ln(` or `log_2(8)` for another base.
